name: is-delulu
description: Dynamic Island-inspired desktop companion for Windows 10 & 11
author: is-delulu

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('out/main/services', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/main/services/gsmtc-daemon.ps1', 'out/main/services/gsmtc-daemon.ps1'); fs.copyFileSync('src/main/services/battery-daemon.ps1', 'out/main/services/battery-daemon.ps1'); fs.copyFileSync('src/main/services/set-wallpaper.ps1', 'out/main/services/set-wallpaper.ps1'); if (fs.existsSync('src/main/services/set-wallpaper.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/services/set-wallpaper.exe', 'out/main/services/set-wallpaper.exe'); fs.copyFileSync('src/main/services/wallpaper-reveal.html', 'out/main/services/wallpaper-reveal.html');"
